mapper.select: SELECT u.id FROM sys_user u WHERE u.is_deleted = FALSE AND u.status = 1 AND u.id <> #{currentUserId} AND u.unit_id IS NOT NULL AND u.unit_id <> #{currentUnitId} AND u.level_no IS NOT NULL AND u.level_no > #{currentLevelNo} AND u.tree_path IS NOT NULL AND u.tree_path NOT LIKE CONCAT(#{treePathPrefix}, '%') ORDER BY u.level_no ASC, u.id ASC
